response: Hi! I'm the CareerGuide assistant. Ask me about the career quiz, universities, scholarships, or your profile.

Use the University Recommender to see universities and programs matched to your marks and interests. Admins keep this list updated with current eligibility criteria.
Check the Scholarship Finder page for scholarships filtered by merit, need, and province. Each listing shows eligibility details and a link to apply.
You can update your personal and academic details anytime from the Profile page. Your quiz results are saved there under Previous recommendations.
For anything I can't answer, please reach out to your institution's career counselling office.
